```{r}
df <- read.csv("/Users/silkemaus/Downloads/PhD/April26/cyclo_EGU/1408_1410.csv")
colnames(df)

series <- data.frame(
  depth = df$Depth.comp..mcd...two.site.composite..Depth.CCS....,
  CaFe = df$Ca_Fe,
  Age = df$Age_Ma
)
colnames(series) <- c("depth", "CaFe", "Age")

series <- subset(series, depth >= 50 & depth <= 240)
series_1 <- subset(series, depth >= 50 & depth <= 100)

series_2 <- subset(series, depth >= 100 & depth <= 150)

series_3 <- subset(series, depth >= 150 & depth <= 240)



range(series_3$Age)
```

Depth Span: 190 m Age Span: 6.39796 Myr --> 6397.96 kyr

--> SR = 190m/6.39796 Myr = 29.6970 m/Myr --> 2.97 cm/kyr

```{r}
# precession

#freq_sig_pre <- c(
  #1.611070,
  #1.715248,
  #1.874145
#)
#neighbouring frequencies from cluster
freq_sig_pre <- c(
  1.597390,
  1.715248,
  1.874145
)
CaFe_asm_pre <- asm(freq = freq_sig_pre,
                    target = target_pre,
                    rayleigh = 0.005261773,
                    nyquist = 10,
                    fper = rep(0.3, length(target_pre)),
                    numsed = 100,
                    sedmin = 2,
                    sedmax = 8,
                    iter = 300,
                    genplot = TRUE,
                    output = TRUE,
                    linLog = 1)
```
